rule: Spelling only, and only inside quoted strings the game prints. Tokens, line numbers, logic, REM comments and spacing are unchanged, except two line-specific layout fixes where a corrected line would otherwise exceed 63 columns (a 64-column line leaves a blank line; 65 wraps). Line pointers are recomputed for the new lengths with the original memory base.

layout.reason: TOO makes this line 64 columns, which prints an extra blank line
Corrected spelling makes this line 65 columns, which wraps YOU onto its own line
